svg.title: Module ownership and cross-layer relations
svg.desc: Six responsibility lanes list orchestration, Rails, tools, API, Env, and drivers. Side panels show skill workflows, WorldState snapshots, ExecutionMemory, and shared perception, motion, and kinematics algorithms. Session assembly and shared result types are shown separately at the bottom.
svg.text: Locate code by responsibility. Solid arrows show selected calls; dashed arrows show planning inputs or results.
Config → make_builder → RobotSession; connect Env, manage sidecars, clean up on exit.
API, perception, and motion share result types; algorithm modules do not import the API layer.
